reproduction.rationale: Same original empirical neural observations and approved source eligibility, PAC labels and common selection metadata; any author-derived PAC labels/common preprocessing must be disclosed in both conditions. Held-out category labels and source accuracy/selected solutions remain protected evaluation material. Pinned SBCAT-release-NWB a25e8cc3f61630a428f190381745257d4506f148 is official but supplies a binary simulated geometry example, not recovered empirical fitcecoc/greedy code. Code-assisted pairing remains blocked until the exact empirical author implementation is found; do not substitute locally written decoder or simulation as official code. Recover full Figure6 session/patient/neuron eligibility and source PAC/non-PAC condition incidence, original counting windows/z-scoring and all selected ensembles. Recover authentic empirical fitcecoc/greedy source entrypoint, dependency versions and exact original random-draw/reproduction policy. Recover complete five-category accuracy traces, source peak/selection behavior, matched ablation outputs and strongest original comparator. Preserve mandatory Figure6c/g/h contribution/projection companions without optimizing significance or geometry effects. Qualify original trial partitions, dependence-aware patient/session uncertainty, tolerances, comparison/budgets and independent full-support execution; source-code assisted condition unavailable until empirical code recovery. Full-panel comparator and improvement admission require a source-faithful multi-endpoint comparison route; current scalar improvement engine cannot admit this vector. No invented mean, win count or easy source cell may replace complete support.
